sectionedDataTableBlock.title: Sectioned table
sectionedDataTableBlock.description: Switch grouping dimensions with independent section headers, previews and group actions.
sectionedDataTableBlock.compositionBody: Composes Container, Tabs, DataTable, Badge and InputGroup. Each expanded section uses the existing DataTable, with repeated column headers and shared sorting and column settings. Uses existing surface, typography and Badge tokens.
sectionedDataTableBlock.behaviorBody: Switch between dimensions without clearing search or filters. Each section initially shows 3 records, with independent collapse and show-more state remembered per dimension and value. Counts and summary slots include every matching record before preview limits. Sorting any section updates every section.
sectionedDataTableBlock.integrationBody: Pass complete data, columns, stable getRowId and a nonempty dimensions array. Each dimension names an existing columnId whose accessor returns a stable string. Optional groups define order, label, description and Badge color; unknown values remain visible. The active grouping column is removed from each section. Set enableHiding=false on dimension columns. This block is for complete client datasets with single-level grouping, not remote pagination or lazy loading.
sectionedDataTableBlock.dataApi: Complete records, business column definitions and stable record IDs. Demo data is exported separately.
sectionedDataTableBlock.groupsApi: Nonempty dimension definitions containing columnId, label and optional ordered groups.
sectionedDataTableBlock.previewApi: Initial records per expanded section, normalized to at least 1; does not affect filtering or counts.
sectionedDataTableBlock.expandedApi: Controlled or uncontrolled grouping dimension; callbacks wait for the host to return a new groupBy. Invalid IDs fall back to the first dimension.
sectionedDataTableBlock.headerApi: Title, description, actions and renderStats for matching-record metrics.
sectionedDataTableBlock.slotsApi: renderFilters receives the shared table; renderSummary receives every matching record and the total.
sectionedDataTableBlock.activationApi: Active record highlight and row activation; nested controls do not activate rows.
sectionedDataTableBlock.stateApi: Ready, loading and error states with column-aligned Skeleton, empty-state handling and optional retry.
sectionedDataTableBlock.labelsApi: Text overrides; sectionedDataTableZhLabels and sectionedDataTableEnLabels are exported.
sectionedDataTableBlock.addApi: Optional creation intent with stable columnId and value. The host owns actual creation; absent callbacks hide the add button.
